_note: Interference policy for the shipped GTSIO-520-H R10 study file (web/gtsio520-r10-static-opt1.glb.gz, audited in its plain form from scripts/decode_model.mjs) when its core cycle and exploded layouts are posed by the viewer's procedural sampler (scripts/audit_procedural_poses.py). Touching is always allowed; overlap is not. known_defects is a ratchet: it records what the CURRENTLY PUBLISHED draft still contains in the sampled cycle (159 pairs until 20 October 2026, then 2 after the piston skirt relief and the turning of the shaft- and gear-mounted parts), may only shrink, and an entry that is no longer observed fails the audit until it is removed. The assembled-pose audit has no ledger (cad-studies/gtsio520-h-static/interference-policy.json). Recording an overlap here is not an acceptance of it.

known_defects.reason: Real geometry, seen only once the gears turn (found 20 October 2026, after the held-fixed parts were fixed). The accessory idler gear (z -48 to -36 mm, tip radius 56.75 mm) and the left magneto gear (teeth z -37 to -25 mm, tip radius 30.8 mm) overlap axially by 1 mm and their axes are 86.8 mm apart, so their tooth tips pass through each other by up to 0.75 mm radially (0.35 mm thick, about 1.5 mm3) at some crank angles. The two gears are not meant to mesh: the idler gear at z -36 to -24 drives the magneto gear, the accessory idler gear drives the separate accessory gears. Not a motion error: with the declared rates every meshing pair of the train stays clear in all 144 sampled poses.
known_defects.fix: Open. Move the accessory idler gear or the magneto gear 1 mm along its axis, or trim 1 mm off the magneto gear teeth: a change to the estimated gear placement in the accessory-drive recipe, not made here.
